First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Community Ride at Charlie Daniels Park group ride

A casual Monday ride on Mt. Juliet's greenways, about 15 miles. New cyclists are encouraged to come and ride with experienced club members at a comfortable pace. Helmets are required and the club asks everyone to register on its site first.
